verdicts.reason: A keeps the original layout, with the big lettering on the left and the quote on clean white space at the right. But the top row of ART words is sliced off at the canvas edge so the brand wordmarks don't read, and a new magenta 'T' block crowds the quote on the right. B moves the quote to the far left, jammed against beige and purple fragments, and leaves a large empty white band in the middle. Its lettering is cropped to unreadable bits along the top and bottom edges, so the original's bold letterform imagery is lost.
